name: Ruul Eagletalon
summary: At Bloodhoof Village, Ruul Eagletalon watches the settlement’s borders. He keeps an eye on Mulgore’s wildlife, especially the aggressive Windfury harpies pressing into tauren lands.

sections.title: Watcher of Bloodhoof
sections.body: Ruul Eagletalon tends to Bloodhoof Village’s security as young braves arrive from Camp Narache. Mulgore is a peaceful homeland beside the arid wastes of the Barrens, yet territorial predators and hostile creatures still press against its pastures. Ruul watches for dangers on the nearby plains and directs capable travelers against the savage Windfury harpies, which prey on unwary nomads and game.

faq.answer: Ruul Eagletalon watches over Bloodhoof Village and directs travelers against threats across Mulgore.

faq.q: What threat does Ruul Eagletalon ask travelers to deal with?
faq.answer: Ruul warns travelers about aggressive Windfury harpies in Mulgore and asks capable braves to reduce their numbers before they harm the village.

faq.q: Where can Ruul Eagletalon be found?
faq.answer: Ruul Eagletalon can be found on the grounds of Bloodhoof Village, by the shores of Stonebull Lake in central Mulgore.

angles.text: As a tauren, you know the vigilance needed to keep Mulgore safe from territorial predators and winged raiders.
